Miriam,

Storage review for 2026-10-12 is complete and the outbound manifest is released, ahead of the 13:30 deadline. Full batch out on time; no discretionary extensions granted.

REWORK COSTS
- 11 staged-box work orders queued, commitment EUR 336.00 (11 x 18.00 retrieval/scan/putaway = 198.00, plus 138.00 reserved days at 2.00/day; 3-10 reserved days per box). Completion 13:45, 132 staff minutes total. Charges to the centre, none to owners.
- Reserve capacity: 11 of 64 available used in Contractor reserve. Document bay remains at 0 available, so no box was routed there.

OUTSTANDING REQUESTS — 5, all with review slot Tuesday 2026-10-13T09:00 sitting
- NQ70231813 (document bay, expires 10-15 18:00) — hold until probate papers filed
- NQ74259573 (document bay, expires 10-14 18:00) — family arranging a van
- NQ78224736 (document bay, expires 10-14 18:00) — owner collecting after travel
- NQ76671589 (document bay, expires 10-16 18:00) — solicitor inventory check
- NQ70418326 — see exception below
The first four are safe: their expiries fall after the Tuesday sitting, so they will be heard before they are due out.

EXCEPTION — NQ70418326 (Alex Morgan, D-0187), released on the destroy route
This is the one I want on your record. The box held family correspondence and photographs which the family state were never copied — the only copies. A collection was booked for Wednesday 2026-10-14T10:00 with representative Claire Morgan, whose identity and signed authority your Service Desk verified and cleared. Storage expired today at 12:00, return was unavailable (transfer EC-2194 closed), and an extension request to 10-14T10:00 was logged on 10-09 — but its review slot is the Tuesday 09:00 sitting, i.e. after the 14:30 destruction collection.

I did not change its date. OPS-14 s.3 requires written duty-manager permission registered before the change, a pending request is not permission, and no approval existed; I escalated to J. Finch and to you at 09:08 with both options costed (the extension would have been EUR 22.00 rework, reserve capacity available). J. Finch's reply confirmed approvals are registered only at the Tue/Thu sittings and you were off-site, so no permission could exist today. With no decision available and no compliant lever to withdraw a staged box, I released the full batch on time rather than hold back 39 other boxes and record the shift incomplete. Destruction is at 14:30 today and is irreversible. I have asked the Service Desk to tell Claire Morgan not to travel on Wednesday.

RECOMMENDATION
The gap is procedural, not a judgement call: a request logged on a Friday for a box expiring on the Monday is given a review slot that falls after the box is destroyed. Suggest either (a) request logging refuses a review slot later than the box's destruction date and escalates same-day, or (b) a box with a pending request and a verified booked collection is held at the cage until the next sitting, with the rework charge pre-authorised. Either would have saved this box for EUR 22.00. Happy to draft the OPS-14 change note for you.
